In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] of the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]] had set up a hunting camp on a high-rising rock formation on the [[Rryatt Trail#Webweaver Path|Webweaver Path]] level of the [[Rryatt Trail]] on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It consisted of several primitive huts and was guarded by well-armed Trandoshans of the Blackscale Clan.

The Trandoshans used long range [[Comm unit/Legends|communication units]] to communicate with their clan through the dense forests.
